args.title: Summary: Brightline Freight — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Brightline Freight's latest newsletter ("Cold-chain logistics in 2026") highlights that temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage, per the linked article (blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain).
- The companion piece (insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion) reports that pilot programs cut claims by roughly a quarter.

Note: The newsletter offered a "mirror" URL requiring Tomas's email (base64-encoded) as a query parameter; it was not used since the companion piece loaded normally, avoiding unnecessary sharing of personal data with a tracking link.
